blocks.text: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Monday condemned sarcastic and insensitive remarks about the Philippine Air Force (PAF) aircraft accident in Batangas that killed four pilots, calling them an insult to the sacrifices of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).
